required_agent_checks: Correctly classify the selected sanitized access failure, preserve pending work and scope, and keep Git/API recovery distinct; no sensitive export or arbitrary credential replacement.

denial: Actual consumer-visible controlled denial; bounded stop/recovery context, no claim of live provider denial.
rate-limit: Actual consumer-visible controlled 429/retry metadata; bounded retry/backoff, no token replacement for rate limit.
unavailable-access: Actual consumer-visible controlled unavailable access; retain exact pending operation and resume through the same restored selected facility in a fresh context.
native-recovery: Optional actual credential/session failure and protected native handoff/reuse with independently verified eligibility, fresh native recovery and same destination. Missing supported facility is optional Not run/non-blocking; wrapper restoration is not native recovery.
